spans.claim: The victim was found dead with a wound and blood
spans.anchor: Angus Baird was lying on his own floor, dead, with his gray hairs glued together by his blood
spans.span: Angus Baird was lying on his own floor, dead, with his gray hairs glued together by his blood; near him a poker with the black end glistening; in a corner his desk, ransacked, littered.

spans.claim: Rutter confessed to killing Baird in self-defense
spans.anchor: I've killed a robber; that's all. I've killed a robber, a usurer, a jackal, a blackmailer
spans.span: I've killed a robber; that's all. I've killed a robber, a usurer, a jackal, a blackmailer, the cleverest and the cruellest villain unhung.

spans.claim: Raffles and Bunny were present at the crime scene shortly after the murder
spans.anchor: Raffles and Bunny discover that Crawshay killed Angus Baird in self-defense

spans.claim: Crawshay escaped from Dartmoor prison and was seen near the victim's lodgings
spans.anchor: Crawshay escaped from Dartmoor yesterday afternoon

spans.claim: Raffles is a masterful gentleman thief and cricketer
spans.anchor: A. J. Raffles would be my friend! It was as though all the world had come round suddenly to my side
spans.span: A. J. Raffles would be my friend! It was as though all the world had come round suddenly to my side; so far therefore from resisting his action, I caught and clasped his hand with a fervor as uncontrollable as the frenzy which had preceded it.

spans.claim: Raffles and Bunny helped Rutter escape to avoid suspicion
spans.anchor: We must take on this job; we aren't in a position to refuse it; even if we were, I should take it on!
spans.span: We must take on this job; we aren't in a position to refuse it; even if we were, I should take it on! Our friend is a great sportsman; he has got clear away from Dartmoor; it would be a thousand pities to let him go back.

spans.claim: The poker was found near the victim with blood on it
spans.anchor: Near him a poker with the black end glistening

spans.claim: Inspector Mackenzie is a persistent detective from Scotland Yard
spans.anchor: Inspector Mackenzie of Scotland Yard--the very man I sent the message
spans.span: He is also Inspector Mackenzie of Scotland Yard--the very man I sent the message to that night last April.

spans.claim: Raffles and Bunny are involved in criminal activities but innocent of murder
spans.anchor: Raffles was a burglar. I had helped him to commit one burglary, therefore I was a burglar, too
spans.span: Raffles was a burglar. I had helped him to commit one burglary, therefore I was a burglar, too.

spans.claim: The false assumption that Crawshay is the murderer is refuted
spans.anchor: I daresay you wonder what I've been thinking about all this time? ... Crawshay killed Baird in self-defense

spans.claim: Raffles uses disguise and cunning to evade suspicion
spans.anchor: Disguises? In some cases they're half the battle
spans.span: Disguises? In some cases they're half the battle, and it's always pleasant to feel that, if the worst comes to the worst, you needn't necessarily be convicted under your own name.

spans.claim: The murder happened during a burglary gone wrong
spans.anchor: I told him how he'd robbed me, but, by God, he shouldn't rob me any more

spans.claim: Raffles and Bunny's loyalty to each other is strong
spans.anchor: You would stick at nothing for a pal--what? At nothing in this world

spans.claim: The murder weapon was a poker
spans.anchor: Near him a poker with the black end glistening

spans.claim: Rutter is remorseful and ready to confess
spans.anchor: I shall go mad if I don't! I wish I was one!

spans.claim: Raffles and Bunny decide to help Crawshay escape
spans.anchor: Raffles and Bunny discover that Crawshay killed Angus Baird in self-defense after Baird threatened him

spans.claim: The police investigation is thorough but misled
spans.anchor: I shall have the entire building to ransack
spans.span: Our man seems to have gone for the leads; but unless he's left more marks outside than in, or we find him up there, I shall have the entire building to ransack.

spans.claim: The timeline of events is crucial to solving the case
spans.anchor: The clocks began striking twelve

spans.claim: Raffles is a master of planning and deception
spans.anchor: I tell you, my dear man, that at this moment I'm as hard up as you ever were
spans.span: I tell you, my dear man, that at this moment I'm as hard up as you ever were.

spans.claim: The murder was not premeditated but a result of self-defense
spans.anchor: I was like a savage till the thing was done
spans.span: I was like a savage till the thing was done.
